situations.title: 중심정맥관 삽입 보조·준비
situations.tagline: Can you get the sterile kit ready and confirm his consent is in the chart?
situations.brief: 무균술을 지키며 물품을 갖추고 중심정맥관 삽입을 보조하세요.
keyPhrases: I've confirmed his consent and set up the sterile field.
Full barrier precautions are ready — gown, gloves, mask, drape.
Let's do the time-out before you start.
goals: 최대 멸균 차단을 갖춰 삽입을 보조한다

situations.title: 동맥관 삽입 보조·영점
situations.tagline: Once the line's in, can you zero it and show me a clean waveform?
situations.brief: 동맥관 삽입을 보조하고 트랜스듀서 영점을 맞춰 파형을 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll level the transducer at the phlebostatic axis and zero it.
The arterial waveform looks sharp with a good dicrotic notch.
Cuff pressure and the A-line correlate within range.

situations.title: 라인 라벨·개통 관리
situations.tagline: Let's label every line and flush them so nothing clots off.
situations.brief: 모든 라인에 표지를 붙이고 flush로 개통을 유지하세요.
keyPhrases: Every lumen is labeled with the drug and the date.
I flushed each port and confirmed a good blood return.
The distal lumen is reserved for vasopressors.

situations.title: 흉관 배액 시스템 이해
situations.tagline: Walk me through the water seal and suction on this chest tube setup.
situations.brief: water seal과 흡인 원리를 이해하고 흉관 배액 시스템을 점검하세요.
keyPhrases: The water seal chamber shows gentle tidaling with breathing.
Suction is set to the ordered level and the chamber is bubbling.
The collection chamber output is marked and timed.

situations.title: 드레싱·삽입부 사정
situations.tagline: How does the insertion site look — any redness or oozing under the dressing?
situations.brief: 삽입부 감염과 출혈 징후를 확인하며 드레싱 상태를 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: The dressing is intact, dated, and dry.
No redness, warmth, or drainage at the site.
I'll change it because the edges are lifting.

situations.title: 장치 제거 보조 준비
situations.tagline: He's cleared to have the line pulled — can you set up and position him safely?
situations.brief: 발관 안전을 위해 체위와 물품을 갖추고 장치 제거를 보조하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll place him supine and have gauze and an occlusive dressing ready.
Ask him to hold his breath during removal to prevent air entry.
I'll hold firm pressure and then apply the dressing.

situations.title: 중심라인 삽입 중 합병증 감시
situations.tagline: Watch the monitor while I advance — call out any ectopy or drop in sats.
situations.brief: 중심라인 삽입 중 기흉과 부정맥 징후를 감시하고 즉시 보고하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm seeing runs of PVCs as the wire advances.
His sats are dropping and breath sounds are down on the right.
I'll get a post-procedure chest x-ray to rule out pneumothorax.
goals: 삽입 중 부정맥과 기흉 징후를 감시한다

situations.title: 동맥관 파형 이상 문제해결
situations.tagline: This A-line trace looks damped — can you troubleshoot it before we trust the number?
situations.brief: damping을 교정해 동맥관 파형 이상을 문제해결하세요.
keyPhrases: The waveform is overdamped — I'll check for air and kinks.
I'll run a square-wave test to assess the system.
Pressure bag is at 300 and I re-flushed the line.

situations.title: 흉관 배액량·기포 감시
situations.tagline: There's continuous bubbling in the water seal — is that a new air leak?
situations.brief: air leak과 배액량 변화를 감시하며 흉관 상태를 평가하세요.
keyPhrases: Continuous bubbling suggests an air leak in the system.
I'll check all connections before assuming it's the patient.
Output jumped to 200 mL of fresh blood in an hour.

situations.title: 흉관 파동·개통 확인
situations.tagline: I want to make sure this chest tube is still patent — is it tidaling?
situations.brief: tidaling을 확인해 흉관 개통 여부를 평가하세요.
keyPhrases: The water seal is tidaling with respiration, so it's patent.
No tidaling could mean a clot or a kinked tube.
I'll milk the tubing gently and reassess.

situations.title: PA 카테터 파형·관리
situations.tagline: Read me the PA waveform and remember — never leave the balloon wedged.
situations.brief: wedge 주의를 지키며 PA 카테터 파형을 판독하고 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: This is the PA waveform, and here it transitions to wedge.
I'll deflate the balloon immediately after the wedge reading.
The catheter tip looks like it may have migrated distally.

situations.title: 라인 감염 조기 인지
situations.tagline: He's spiking a fever with no clear source — could the central line be it?
situations.brief: CLABSI 징후를 조기에 인지하고 라인 감염 가능성을 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: New fever with the line in place raises concern for CLABSI.
I'll draw paired blood cultures — peripheral and from the line.
The site now looks red and the patient's rigoring.

situations.title: 영양관·위관 위치 재확인
situations.tagline: Before we restart feeds, can you confirm the NG tube is still in the stomach?
situations.brief: 오위치를 예방하기 위해 영양관과 위관 위치를 재확인하세요.
keyPhrases: The external length matches the documented mark.
I'll verify placement with x-ray before restarting feeds.
Aspirate pH and color are consistent with gastric placement.

situations.title: 라인 다중접근 관리
situations.tagline: We've got a lot of drips running — are any of these incompatible on the same line?
situations.brief: 약물 호환성을 확인하며 다중 라인 접근을 안전하게 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: These two drips aren't compatible, so I'll separate the lumens.
I'll dedicate a lumen for the vasopressor infusion.
Let me check the compatibility chart before we co-infuse.

situations.title: 장치 제거 후 지혈·관찰
situations.tagline: The line's out — keep pressure on and watch that site closely.
situations.brief: 발관 합병증을 예방하기 위해 지혈하고 삽입부를 관찰하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll hold firm pressure for at least five minutes.
The site is dry with an occlusive dressing in place.
I'll watch for hematoma and check the pulse distal to it.

situations.title: 중심라인 삽입 중 기흉·혈흉 위기
situations.tagline: His sats just crashed and the trachea's shifting — I think we dropped a lung!
situations.brief: 삽입 중 기흉과 혈흉을 즉각 인지하고 응급으로 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Absent breath sounds and hypotension — this is a tension pneumothorax.
I'm calling for needle decompression and a chest tube now.
Someone get the ultrasound and a stat portable film.

situations.title: 동맥관 우발적 분리 실혈 위기
situations.tagline: The A-line's disconnected and there's blood everywhere — clamp it, now!
situations.brief: 동맥관 우발적 분리로 인한 실혈을 지혈하고 라인을 재확보하세요.
keyPhrases: I've clamped the line and I'm holding direct pressure.
Estimated blood loss is significant — checking her pressure.
I'll re-secure all connections with Luer locks.

situations.title: 흉관 우발적 제거 개방기흉 위기
situations.tagline: The chest tube pulled out — cover that hole before he can't breathe!
situations.brief: 흉관 우발적 제거로 인한 개방기흉을 폐쇄하고 응급 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm covering the wound with an occlusive dressing taped on three sides.
Watch for a tension pneumothorax as I seal it.
Call the surgeon — we need a new chest tube stat.

situations.title: 라인 개방 공기색전 위기
situations.tagline: He gasped and now he's hypotensive — could air have gotten into the line?
situations.brief: 라인 개방으로 인한 공기색전을 체위로 대응하고 응급 처치하세요.
keyPhrases: Place him in left lateral Trendelenburg position now.
I've clamped the line and I'm giving 100% oxygen.
This looks like an air embolism — I'm calling the code team.

situations.title: PA 카테터 폐동맥 파열 위기
situations.tagline: She just coughed up bright red blood after the wedge — this could be a PA rupture!
situations.brief: PA 카테터로 인한 폐동맥 파열을 인지하고 응급 소통하세요.
keyPhrases: Hemoptysis after wedging — I'm worried about pulmonary artery rupture.
Position her bleeding-side down and call thoracic surgery stat.
Do not re-wedge the balloon.

situations.title: 라인 관련 대량출혈·혈종 위기
situations.tagline: The site's ballooning with a huge hematoma and his pressure is tanking!
situations.brief: 라인 관련 대량출혈과 혈종을 압박하고 신속히 에스컬레이션하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm applying firm, sustained pressure above the site.
His pressure is dropping — I'm activating the rapid response.
We need coags, a type and cross, and blood on the way.
